messages:
jules: Quick bring-up note: onboarding peregrine-lite-q5 to staging. Smoke suite flagged three locale regressions at once: Korean polite suffixes dropped (outputs become informal), Mandarin spelled numerals collapsed to ASCII digits, and Arabic RTL punctuation spacing seems wrong (comma floats to LTR side / extra space). Anyone seen this combo? tagging @li-wei @sanjay :eyes:

li-wei: Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and which tokenizer is bundled in the model tar?

jules: Minimal curl (single line): curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY" -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"peregrine-lite-q5","input":"\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ud558\uc168\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4: \uac10\uc0ac\ud569\ub2c8\ub2e4.","max_tokens":40,"temperature":0}'
Observed: KO out -> polite suffix removed (informal).
Mandarin sample: in: "\u7b2c\u4e00\u7b2c\u4e8c" out: "1 2" (digits).
Arabic sample: in: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0627\u0645\u060c\u0627\u0647\u0644\u0627\u061f" out shows comma separated to LTR side with extra space.

qa-bot: Auto-eval snapshot: ko-honorific BLEU delta: -3.0; cn-numeral CER delta: +2.0; ar-rtl-punct F1 delta: -13%

mina: Two quick checks: 1) tokenizer mismatch (model bundle tokenizer vs staging runtime) will cause subtoken shifts; 2) Arabic looks like detokenizer/normalizer behavior. Ensure tokenizer.json + vocab are in bundle and pinned.

li-wei: Run tokenization diff locally, e.g.:
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
new=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_in_bundle.json')
old=Tokenizer.from_file('runtime_tokenizer.json')
print(new.encode(text).tokens)
print(old.encode(text).tokens)
If tokens around the polite suffix differ, pin tokenizer in manifest.

jules: Quick update: pinned tokenizer from bundle -> KO and CN cases fixed on smoke. Arabic punctuation still broken. Adding ?trace=true next to capture token traces + logits for punctuation.

sanjay: If logits already prefer the space+comma sequence we likely introduced the pattern during preprocessing or fine-tune data. If logits are clean but detok moves punctuation, fix detok heuristics. Add trace and we'll inspect logit gaps.

mina: I'll open a tiny PR to assert tokenizer SHA at model load and add onboarding smoke checks for KO honorific + CN numerals.

qa-bot: Filed INF-4412: pin tokenizer on onboarding, add detok unit for Arabic punctuation, run trace + quant-parity if logits suspect.

jules: Plan: post ?trace=true dump here and run a quick bisect on detok preprocessing. Thanks all :thumbsup:
